frontmatter.title: Transforming lead nurturing: designing an AI-driven prospecting agent for customer home builder and real estate companies.
frontmatter.synopsis: Sales reps spent hours writing personalized outreach that rarely got replies, while a costly BPO team tried to compensate. Lead validation efforts on whether AI could replace or augment that team, and through three small experiments, found why a fully-automated agent wouldn't work, pivoting the project to a human-in-the-loop system before engineering committed resources.

frontmatter.title: リードナーチャリングの変革：注文住宅業者および不動産会社向けのAI駆動型見込み客発掘エージェントの設計
frontmatter.synopsis: 営業担当者は返信がほとんど来ないパーソナライズされたアウトリーチメールの作成に何時間も費やしており、高コストなBPOチームがその補完を担っていた。AIがそのチームに取って代わるか、または補完できるかについてのリード検証を主導し、3つの小規模な実験を通じて、完全自動化エージェントが機能しない理由を明らかにした。その結果、エンジニアリングチームがリソースを投入する前に、プロジェクトをヒューマン・イン・ザ・ループ型のシステムへと方向転換させた。

frontmatter.title: Making The Process Of Acquiring and Understanding New Lead Behavior More Efficient For Real Estate Agents.
frontmatter.synopsis: Digima, a web-based CRM application, aims to provide small to medium size real estate companies with a way to understand their customers' needs. Despite the fact that most real estate company's main lead acquisition channels were portal sites like SUUMO,  Digima did not provide a way to automatically import these leads into Digima, leading to an increase in manual work and a loss of valuable information for our users.
